descriptiveName: Fachada gris de siete vanos y rejas

supersedes.scope: opening count and descriptive name only
supersedes.reason: The complete frontage crosses the P03 panorama seam. Inspecting both ends reveals the narrow openings omitted by the earlier five-bay simplification.

primaryImageInspection.method: Visual inspection of original panorama and enlarged seam; P04 confirms the oblique eastern end. No photograph changed or applied as a model texture.

references.observation: Mismo frente gris de arcos, pilastras, rejas y balaustrada, partido por la costura horizontal del panorama; cubierta OB-01 contigua al oeste.
Mismo frente gris al oeste desde una posición más oriental; colindante claro de vanos rectangulares permite distinguir el límite del frente.

limits: Count and order are morphological observations; dimensions and ironwork pattern remain estimates.
No confirmed commercial attribution, photograph date or original panorama heading.
Roof and rear extent retain their independent uncertainty.
